d: Jio Platforms has made a landmark stock market debut, opening at ₹1,358 per share, more than 21% above its IPO price, and reaching a market valuation of around $137 billion. In this video, Firstpost examines how the $3.17 billion IPO attracted massive investor demand and propelled Jio to become India’s second-most valuable listed company, behind Reliance Industries. Together, Reliance and Jio now command a combined market value of around $320 billion, putting the Reliance Group ahead of the Tata Group as India’s most valuable business conglomerate.
